title: Approximate Muon with low-rank adapters
abstract: arXiv:2608.14492v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The Muon optimizer shows clear benefits versus alternatives when pretraining neural networks. However, it is used less frequently for parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT). One potential reason is that the most common PEFT method, LoRA, does not naturally combine with Muon since it is not mathematically possible to orthogonalize the weight update given by a low-rank parameterization. In this paper, we address this issue by approximating the solution to a relaxed Muon objective in the low-rank setting via linearization and then least-squares. We provide an efficient implementation that uses matmul operations only, as opposed to more complex linear algebra decomposition routines. Our method, sMuon (small Muon), performs favourably across SFT and a ReLoRA pretraining experiment. While results are model- and eval-dependent, we find overall that using Muon for low-rank fine-tuning provides moderate performance improvements.

translated_title: 低秩适配器下的近似Muon优化器
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14492v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：Muon优化器在预训练神经网络时相较于替代方案显示出明显优势。然而，它在参数高效微调（PEFT）中使用较少。一个潜在原因是，最常见的PEFT方法LoRA与Muon自然结合存在困难，因为从数学上无法对低秩参数化给出的权重更新进行正交化。本文通过线性化并采用最小二乘法，在低秩设置下近似求解松弛的Muon目标，从而解决这一问题。我们提供了一种仅使用矩阵乘法操作的高效实现，而非更复杂的线性代数分解例程。我们的方法sMuon（小型Muon）在监督微调（SFT）和ReLoRA预训练实验中表现良好。虽然结果因模型和评估而异，但总体发现，使用Muon进行低秩微调可带来适度的性能提升。
tldr: 本文提出sMuon方法，通过线性化和最小二乘法在低秩设置下近似Muon优化器，使LoRA等参数高效微调能与Muon结合，并仅用矩阵乘法实现高效计算，带来适度性能改进。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces sMuon, which approximates the Muon optimizer in low-rank settings via linearization and least-squares, enabling combination with LoRA for parameter-efficient fine-tuning with efficient matmul-only implementation and moderate performance gains.
